title: TrendSummary
description: A computed, scored trend derived from one or more normalized-content items, ready for display in the dashboard.

trend_score.description: Overall transparent trend score. Formula is not finalized; see docs/trend-scoring.md.

growth_7d.description: Percentage change in trend signal over the trailing 7 days, if available.

source_count.description: Number of distinct data sources contributing to this trend.

supporting_item_count.description: Number of normalized-content items supporting this trend.
